text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report presents the results of staff's investigation of a request to have an all-way stop control installed at the intersection of Mary Chapman Boulevard and Mainshep Road. A staff assessment has determined that the installation of an all-way stop control is warranted and recommended at this intersection. The proposed all-way stop control will help improve traffic management and pedestrian safety at this location.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way stop control at the intersection of Mary Chapman Boulevard and Mainshep Road.
